best_hook.why: 'A public execution after a wedding.' - a grotesque premise in one line, delivered with a chuckle

best_cliffhanger.why: Clarissa's 'Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place' - the public execution is set and celebrated, nothing stops it yet

must_promos.why: Aristocrats gleefully frame the execution as a warning to women who rise, then cut to the starving, chained Juliana dragging herself up to defy them - villain vs victim with the execution still looming
Opens on a tear-stained shackled woman refusing to surrender, then the gloating noblewoman confirms she will be executed and ends on the chilling 'forgets her place' toast

standalone_risk: A stranger never learns what Juliana is accused of or how Clarissa and her husband relate to her; the villains are side characters toasting someone off screen
notes: Mostly gloating dialogue; the dungeon scene supplies the only strong visual.
